entry.title: Overcast 1.0.6
entry.summary: Mutable Instruments Clouds with the Parasites firmware (six modes) plus a modulation page: two envelopes, two LFOs and an 8-slot matrix onto Clouds' CV inputs, and a built-in manual. **SHA-256** `Overcast-1.0.6-mpc-armv7.zip`: `18f8a48194bd57ec1c05c099e59c0b2b79f56fac67a88747e17930a300f1c0f0` ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM: MPC Live / Live II, One, X, Key 61, Force). The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock
